item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day is stacked end to end, and it's easy to let water slide when you're moving between commitments. Heat, coffee, and a full schedule drain you faster than you'd think. Don't wait until you're thirsty — that's already too late. Keep water within reach and sip steadily, not just at meals. Action: fill a bottle right now and finish it before your first afternoon check-in.
